info.name: PANGAEA Data Download Services DOI Filter API

params.name: datasetDOI
params.description: DOI of the PANGAEA dataset to retrieve. When used alone, returns the entire dataset. Can be the full DOI URI or just the suffix.

params.name: columns
params.description: Comma-delimited list of column numbers to include in the response (no spaces). If omitted, all columns are returned.

params.name: filterParameterValue
params.description: Filter rows by parameter value. Format is "column:value" or "column:>value" or "column:<value". Multiple filters use AND logic; multiple values within a filter use OR logic. Can be repeated.

items.docs: Retrieve tabular dataset data filtered by dataset DOI and optional parameter values. Supports column selection, value filtering with range queries, and multiple filter criteria with AND/OR logic. Returns tab-delimited data files.
